original.statement: Cilium agent MTU auto-detection is now continuous during the agent lifetime, so changing a device MTU no longer requires an agent restart to be picked up.

decision.reason: [ev-01a5226ddc9a] states that MTU auto-detection is now continuous during agent lifetime, so a device MTU change no longer needs an agent restart. That is a runtime change to how the same feature works, with no added, removed or renamed setting, so behavior-changed is the right type. The subject name mtu-auto-detection uses the evidence's own key words. The validators were inconclusive (not render-verifiable) and contradict nothing.
